This page is from archive cote 129: notes of the seminar Grothendieck gave at Montréal in 1970 on Barsotti-Tate groups and Dieudonné theory, written up by Delale, Labute, Hakim and Messing; copies of annotated typescripts, in French; site page 1 (PDF page 2). Chapter I, "Préliminaires sur Witt" (title page at site 1). The handwriting may be Grothendieck's or the note-takers'. The notation is that of the period (W_n, F, V, \underline{Z}_p, Spec, script letters); write it as typed or written. The printed version (Groupes de Barsotti-Tate et cristaux de Dieudonné, Presses de l'Université de Montréal, 1974) differs from these notes and is not given. No draft is given for this text: transcribe the page.
